note: AD-139 restaurant (owner 2026-09-23). A resident whose meal is due walks to a free seat of the restaurant, eats there sit_ticks and goes back to work. An invitation lives wait_ticks of the village clock; one that expires is eaten from the pantries by the old way (AD-104) with the same due, so no meal is ever lost. A resident who finds the hall full waits at most wait_ticks for a seat, then eats from the pantries. The hall serves portions: a dish is opened once and what a meal leaves of it (in rations) feeds the next diner, up to leftover_max; it cools at dusk. seat_groups: table groups (a table and two seats) standing at levels I..VI. From level IV a courier (a porter posted at the restaurant) carries portions to residents working further than near_work_radius from the hall, within courier_radius; with a dog of the village (livestock kennel) and a cart the load is courier_cart_portions and the radius courier_cart_radius. keep_items: the food a restaurant keeps in its own chest for the hall before the rest goes to the stock.
